title: The Mega Christmas SVG Design Bundle
author: Graphiccycle
description:
Mega Christmas SVG Bundle includes Christmas SVG quotes, winter SVG, snowflake SVG, deer SVG, Santa SVG, holiday SVG, Jesus SVG, Merry Christmas SVG, nativity SVG and more!
With this INSTANT DOWNLOAD you will receive a ZIP folder, which includes:
– 210 SVG files – For Cricut Explore, Silhouette Designer Edition, Adobe Suite, Inkspace, Corel Draw and more.
– 210 DXF files – For Silhouette users, this format can be open with the free software version of Silhouette.
– 210 EPS files – For Adobe Illustrator, Inkspace, Corel Draw and more.
– 210 PNG files – transparent background, 300 dpi
